title: Per-item SoundSet, synthesised missing SFX, SFX voice pool with stealing
player_outcome: Weapons are recognisable by ear: shotguns boom, snipers crack, staffs zap, crystals chime, food crunches, bombs and knives whoosh when thrown, empty guns click. Sounds are no longer dropped silently when many play at once.
design: Verified: ItemDef.SoundSet (ItemDef.cs:118) is never read. ShotSound falls back to 'swing' for throws. Sfx.Free returns null when 12 players are busy (Sfx.cs:63-68). sfx_recipes.py is 334 lines.

SoundEvents.OnUsed: play item.SoundSet when Sfx.Has(it); otherwise use family rules by ItemUseInfo.Style: gun → gun/gun_heavy; bow → bow; staff/tome → magic/magic_heavy; throw → throw; whip → whip_swing; yoyo → yoyo_throw; flail → flail_spin; eat → eat; drink → potion/mana; holdUp → summon/crystal. Dry fire → dry_fire; NoMana → fizzle.
Sfx: pool 24 2D + 24 3D; per-id max voices (3) with oldest-voice stealing; skip 3D sounds beyond MaxDistance.
tools/audio: split sfx_recipes.py → sfx_recipes.py (core/material) + new sfx_recipes_items.py merged into RECIPES.

New recipes: tink, eat, crystal, mana_crystal, shotgun, sniper, laser, staff_bolt, water_bolt, throw, whip_swing, whip_crack, yoyo_throw, flail_spin, chain, hit_metal, hit_spirit, hit_chitin, death_bone, death_metal, death_spirit, death_chitin, pot_shatter, tree_fall, arrow_hit, dry_fire, fizzle, star_fall, star_land, heart_pickup, mana_star_pickup, bag_open, piggy_bank, sleep_snore.
build_audio.py --check also scans data JSON soundSet/hitSound/deathSound and data/config/creature_materials.json.
ContentValidator: soundSet/hitSound/deathSound must resolve to assets/audio/sfx/<id>.wav or <id>_1.wav (ctx.Asset-style check), so CI catches typos without numpy.
Generate the wavs (/root/bpyenv/bin/python tools/audio/build_audio.py --sfx --only=<ids>), run the Godot import, and commit wav + .import.
files_modify: game/Audio/SoundEvents.cs — SoundSet first; style families; dry fire
game/Audio/Sfx.cs — pool size, voice limits, stealing
tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py — core recipes only; import items recipes
data_changes: soundSet: boomstick, shotgun, tactical_shotgun → 'shotgun'; sniper_rifle → 'sniper'; space_gun, laser_rifle, laser_machinegun → 'laser'; water_bolt → 'water_bolt'; gem staffs → 'staff_bolt'
tests: Smoke: all .cmds PASS with errors == 0 (no audio load errors)
verification: The 'audio test' engine command plays each new id
Listen pass on a lavapipe or desktop build
risks: Later WPs add recipes to sfx_recipes_items.py; serialise edits or append-only sections per WP.
build_audio needs scipy/soundfile (bpy venv); CI does not run it, so the validator check covers references.
